name: web-access
description: Web search (Exa + Tavily with API key rotation), URL content extraction (HTML, PDF, JS-rendered pages) and GitHub search via a local zero-dependency MCP server. Exa works without any key.

tavily_api_keys.title: Tavily API keys
tavily_api_keys.description: Optional. One or more Tavily keys (tvly-...), comma separated — rotated automatically. Enables Tavily search, news/finance topics and PDF/JS page extraction. Free keys at tavily.com.

exa_api_keys.title: Exa API keys
exa_api_keys.description: Optional. One or more Exa keys, comma separated — rotated automatically. Leave empty to use Exa keyless (anonymous, lower limits).

search_provider.title: Default search provider
search_provider.description: auto (Exa first, Tavily fallback), exa, tavily, or both (merge results from both; uses credits on both).
